## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.5

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line (supersedes incomplete `2.6.0-alpha.4`). Same **2.6.r re-check** remediations plus HA add-on Dockerfile fix. Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **Quality / Sonar remediations** — float-eq fix (`ha_units`), Actions SHA pins + job permissions, path/URL hardening, share-root validation, explicit Dockerfile `COPY` + tighter `.dockerignore`
- **Dead-code / KPI simplify** — unused chart/simulation helpers removed; long MILP/battery/mapping functions split
- **HA add-on build fix** — `# NOSONAR` moved off the `FROM` line (BuildKit parse error that aborted the alpha.4 Release after the main image push)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.5` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
